name: Jeweled Letter Opener
full_text: A jeweled letter opener sitting on a reading desk in M3. Worth 20 gp.
summary: 20 gp jeweled letter opener on a reading desk in M3.

name: Silverware Service
full_text: The buffet in M8 contains silverware and a service for six. Worth 20 gp total.
summary: Silverware and service for six in M8 buffet. Worth 20 gp.

name: Driftglobes (Pair)
full_text: Two glowing orbs hanging above the arboretum plants are driftglobes. Cumin and Coriander periodically activate them to provide light for the plants.
summary: Two driftglobes providing light for M9 plants. Magic items.

name: +1 Flail (Martial Attack Techniques)
source_section: M13. THE CHAINED LIBRARY, Treasure, p.24
full_text: If the party defeats the animated chained library, one of its books breaks free with a length of chain still attached and functions as a +1 flail. The book is entitled Martial Attack Techniques.
summary: +1 flail (book with chain) from defeating the animated chained library in M13.

name: Alchemical Materials
full_text: Searching the room yields 50 gp worth of valuable alchemical reagents.
summary: 50 gp of alchemical reagents in M17.

name: Potions of Healing (2)
full_text: Two vials among the alchemical equipment in M17 contain potions of healing.
summary: Two potions of healing in M17.

name: Genuine Helmet and Longsword
full_text: The decorative suit of armor at M10 is purely ornamental, but the helmet and longsword are genuine items of good quality.
summary: Real helmet and longsword (good quality, mundane) from the decorative armor in M10.

name: Elegant Robes and Clothing
full_text: Top drawers of the dresser contain elegant, well-made robes. Lower drawers hold more utilitarian tunics and dresses.
summary: Elegant robes and utilitarian clothing in M15 dresser.
